# Protocols for Business SIG

> A research group of the Protocol Institute studying how organizations coordinate through protocols, and what changes as AI agents join the work. Sessions every other Monday, 15:30–16:30 UTC, on the Protocol Institute Discord (https://discord.gg/zNJdK7caj, channel #protocols-for-business), from 2 November 2026 to 1 November 2027. Sessions are recorded. Drop-ins are welcome.

## Pages
- [About](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/about/): method (protocol vision and Business Protocol Management), origins, facilitators, publications
- [Sessions](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/sessions/): joining details, session format, the year's six themes with sample readings, how to suggest a reading, archive
- [Reading map](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/sessions/map/): 400 readings placed by what they say, with the year's syllabus marked
- [Research](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/research/): 2027 focus (AI Native Data Operations), its three premises (abundant cognition, distributed agency, mediation), research questions, case studies, how to sponsor or partner
- [Case studies](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/research/cases/): water rate data, construction bids from PDFs, the PI brand kit, a sample template
- [Protocol Play](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/play/): protocol watching, workshops, simulation
- [Protocol watching guide](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/play/watching/): how to see and record a business protocol

## Blyg (session notes and research log)
- [Blyg](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/blyg/): session notes and the running research log, published with the Blygger protocol 0.2 (https://blygger.org/)
- [Feed](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/blyg/feed.xml) · [Manifest](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/blyg/blyg.json) · [Archive index](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/blyg/items/index.json)

## Data
- [sessions.json](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/sessions.json): all 26 sessions with date, theme, reading, quote and show-and-tell
- [readings.json](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/sessions/map/readings.json): every reading on the map with its link, citation, area and syllabus theme

## Suggest a reading
Open https://github.com/protocolvision/sig-p4b/issues/new?template=reading-suggestion.yml with the title, link, author and year, the theme it fits, and what it adds. Prefer primary sources, and check that the source exists.
- [Calendar (.ics)](https://npc.here.now/protocolvision/sig-p4b.ics): subscribable; times in UTC

## Next sessions
- 2026-11-02 15:30–16:30 UTC: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead (OpenAI, 2026), https://openai.com/index/hugging-face-incident-and-the-road-ahead/
- 2026-11-16 15:30–16:30 UTC: Patterns and problems in multiagent systems (Anthropic, 2026), https://www.anthropic.com/research/multiagent-systems

## Register for session emails
POST https://sig-p4b-signup.rafaeldf2.workers.dev/signup with Content-Type: application/json.
Body fields: email (required), name, website, github, discord, affiliation. Returns {"ok": true}.
Only register a person with their consent. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.
